cuda_environment.cuda_visible_devices: one explicit full-GPU UUID, never an ordinal
cuda_environment.docker_gpu_selection: host inspection must show exactly one DeviceRequest with Driver empty, Count 0, DeviceIDs containing only the same full-GPU UUID, Capabilities exactly [[gpu]], and Options empty
cuda_environment.docker_exec_visibility: every freeze, acquisition, verifier, and aggregation role runs through docker exec and must observe CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES equal to the requested full-GPU UUID; the long-lived shell PID 1 is not an evidence role
cuda_environment.container_identity: host image inspect and actual-running-container inspect must link one canonical container ID to one immutable image ID and digest-pinned OCI reference
cuda_environment.default_container_hostname: the live process hostname must equal the first 12 hexadecimal characters of the inspected 64-hex container ID
cuda_environment.mount_contract: the inspected container must use network mode none, a read-only root filesystem, the exact one-entry /tmp tmpfs map, exactly the ten predeclared bind destinations and read-only/read-write modes, and a host-captured /proc/<State.Pid>/mountinfo snapshot that matches /proc/self/mountinfo in every live evidence process
cuda_environment.runtime_lock: a sanitized host-generated lock must be committed before acquisition and must match every run exactly
cuda_environment.python_executable_sha256: required in the populated runtime lock
cuda_environment.python_flags: the complete Python 3.12 sys.flags map is pinned to the ordinary nonoptimized, nonisolated image invocation

source_provenance.repository: record contemporaneous HEAD, HEAD tree, origin, submodule status, exact porcelain-v1-z bytes and their SHA-256; require clean
source_provenance.tracked_tree: retain the SHA-256 and byte count of every tracked repository file
source_provenance.loaded_sources: at initialized and completed boundaries, hash every file-backed sys.modules __file__, spec origin, existing cached bytecode, available source file, and every regular file-backed /proc/self/maps pathname; all records use explicit logical roots
source_provenance.late_imports: completed closure may add only explicitly recorded modules or mapped files; removal, relocation, or byte change of an initialized entry aborts, and exact additions must agree across off-A, off-B, and trace-on
source_provenance.executable_origins: module origins and executable mappings are permitted only from the read-only repository, nanoGPT, Muon, image Python environment, or image-layer roots; executable data, preprocessor-alias, writable evidence, /tmp, and /dev/shm origins abort
source_provenance.run_identity: canonical hash of addendum/protocol/erratum, repository, initialized/completed loaded-file closure and additions, frozen run configuration, data identity, live mountinfo-bound runtime map, and runtime-lock hash
source_provenance.independent_verifier: recollect initialized membership after the frozen setup, rehash every initialized/completed retained file, recompute run identity, and compare complete repository/source/runtime maps; an opaque digest comparison is forbidden
source_provenance.sanitized_retention: retain all semantic manifest fields while replacing machine-local absolute paths with deterministic logical-root references

run_sequence.fidelity_prerequisite: both exact repeatability and exact noninterference verifiers must pass with zero mismatches
